name: Adversarial Cycle-Consistent Mesh Reconstruction
definition: An optimization framework for single-view image-to-geometry reconstruction using adversarial training, cycle consistency, and mesh regularization to train networks p2v (image to mesh), a2b (image to volume/voxel), b2a (mesh to image), and a discriminator D.
summary: Adversarial Cycle-Consistent Mesh Reconstruction is an optimization framework that jointly trains networks to predict meshes and volumes from images, distinguished by cycle consistency between domains and explicit mesh regularization.
